title: Not smoothest design but will do job
text: Not smoothest design but will do job. I'm rather disappointed with this stand. There are big gaps and the drawers do not pull out or go back in smoothly.i have to hold the stand with one hand and pull drawer out with other. i have to keep drawers pulled out over assembly bar otherwise they won't pull out. There is not back brace to prevent drawers from being pushed too far in. There are straps on the side but if you use those, you can't pull drawer out to fullest extent.  I do not feel this is worth value being charged.it will do the job but I will have to reconsider next time as I am looking for 2nd stand.
